ECOMATIC (5+5) Eco-Friendly Gift Set | BG30 – Sustainable Corporate Gift Combo

The ECOMATIC (5+5) Eco-Friendly Gift Set | BG30 is a thoughtfully designed sustainable gifting solution for brands, corporates, institutions, and eco-conscious individuals. Created to promote greener habits, this premium eco-friendly gift set includes a versatile mix of plantable stationery essentials that not only reduce waste but also help grow real plants. Each element in the set aligns with modern sustainability standards, making it an excellent choice for corporate gifting, employee welcome kits, event giveaways, student hampers, and environment-friendly promotional campaigns.

This eco-friendly gift set features a combination of plantable pen pencil (5+5) and a plantable notepad B6 (pin), all packed neatly in a jute string bag with cotton net (7″x10″). The entire kit is designed using biodegradable, recycled, and seed-infused materials that help minimize carbon footprint. Once used, the stationery items can be planted to grow herbs, flowers, or vegetables, making the set a meaningful and interactive green experience for recipients.

Why Choose the ECOMATIC (5+5) Eco-Friendly Gift Set | BG30?

The BG30 set is crafted for businesses and individuals looking for an attractive, high-utility, and eco-responsible gifting option. With rising demand for eco-friendly corporate gifts and sustainable promotional items, this plantable gift set provides exceptional value while supporting environmental conservation. The natural jute and cotton net bag adds an organic aesthetic, making it perfect for brands wanting to showcase sustainability in every detail.

Key Features

  • Plantable Pen Pencil (5+5): A set of 5 plantable pens and 5 plantable pencils made using biodegradable materials and seed capsules. After use, plant the stubs to grow real plants.
  • Plantable Notepad B6 (Pin): Eco-friendly notepad with seed-infused recycled paper sheets, promoting a zero-waste writing experience.
  • Eco Packaging: Packed inside a natural jute string bag with cotton net (7″x10″) for a rustic and premium look.
  • Sustainable Materials: Made from recycled paper, biodegradable components, natural jute, and eco-safe inks.
  • Perfect for Corporate Gifting: Ideal for companies focusing on green initiatives, CSR gifting, employee joining kits, event giveaways, and promotional campaigns.
  • Encourages Green Living: Every item can be planted, helping promote environmental awareness and responsible usage.

Benefits of Choosing Plantable Eco-Friendly Gifts

Plantable stationery has emerged as one of the most popular eco-friendly gifting options due to its dual-purpose nature. The ECOMATIC (5+5) Eco-Friendly Gift Set | BG30 not only reduces plastic waste but also contributes to greener surroundings by growing plants. Such gifts are widely appreciated and carry a meaningful message—making them suitable for schools, colleges, NGOs, corporates, and events focused on sustainability and climate responsibility.

Ideal For

  • Corporate gifting & employee welcome kits
  • Eco-friendly promotional giveaways
  • CSR and sustainable brand campaigns
  • School & college environment programs
  • Workshops, seminars, and awareness drives
  • Festive gifting with a purpose

With eco-awareness rising globally, the ECOMATIC (5+5) Eco-Friendly Gift Set | BG30 delivers an impactful gifting experience that aligns with modern sustainability goals. Its plantable pens, plantable pencils, and notepad offer daily usability while encouraging recipients to participate in a greener future. The naturally crafted jute string bag adds elegance, making it a complete zero-waste gift set.

Conclusion

If you are looking for a premium, meaningful, and eco-conscious gift, the ECOMATIC BG30 eco-friendly gift set is the perfect choice. With biodegradable plantable stationery and sustainable packaging, this set stands out as a high-value option for brands that care about the environment. Add it to your gifting collection and promote a greener tomorrow.
